name: Open apps without Tailscale
author: wizard
description: On a box that is not on Tailscale yet, app screens such as Files and Search open inside Wizard on the box's own address instead of being listed as backend-only. The Agent Service serves each app page at the same path Tailscale would give it, only to requests made on the box itself. Read by the Agent Service (server/local-app-routes.mjs); boxes on Tailscale are unchanged.
